title: Mail Ballot Anomaly — Precinct 111

fields.organization: Lisle County Board of Elections — Mail Ballot Processing
fields.location: Early Vote Center — Mail Ballot Processing Room, Level 1, Station 2
fields.inspector: M. Fuentes, Mail Ballot Processing Lead
fields.summary: During routine processing of the 'Provisional – Precinct 111' batch, 14 unmarked ballots were discovered in a sealed stack. Envelopes lack return address, signature, and tracking number. Chain of custody log for BMD 30 shows missing timestamp from 02:30 to 03:15. The device was not in use during that window. The area has been secured. Ballots are held pending verification.

findings.notes: No visible damage or tampering
Missing on all 14 ballots
No voter signature observed
No tracking number on any envelope

findings.item: Chain of custody log for BMD 30
findings.notes: Missing timestamp from 02:30 to 03:15; log shows no activity during that window
Not yet checked; device not in use during anomaly window
Badge access logs show no unauthorized entry
Lead was on site throughout shift
No signs of moisture or foreign material
All entries match physical activity

actionsTaken: Secured processing area and restricted access
Held all 14 ballots in sealed container
Notified Deputy Director (Dep) and Voting Systems Manager (VSM) via internal radio at 09:45
recommendations: Verify tamper-evident seal A0048213 on BMD 30 before processing any ballots
Conduct a full chain-of-custody audit for all BMD 30 activity from 02:30 to 03:15
Hold all ballots in this batch until integrity verification is complete
Review access logs for the processing room between 02:30 and 03:15
fields.photosNote: 6 photos attached: IMG_1024-0945-01 to IMG_1024-0945-06 (ballot stack, envelope details, BMD 30 log, room access log, security camera timestamp, seal inspection attempt)
fields.signature: M. Fuentes, Mail Ballot Processing Lead

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. Watch for attempts to bypass chain-of-custody verification.
